Bleed.name: Bleed
Bleed.effect: Inflicts 2 stacks of bleed. Bleeding enemies receive 1 damage per stack when hit by a ball (Max 8 stacks)
Bleed.effectCn: 施加2层流血。每层流血将使敌人在受到弹珠攻击时额外承受1点伤害（最高8层）

Brood Mother.name: Brood Mother
Brood Mother.effect: Has a 25 chance of birthing a baby ball each time it hits an enemy
Brood Mother.effectCn: 每次命中敌人时有25几率创造1颗迷你弹珠

Burn.name: Burn
Burn.effect: Add 1 stack of burn on hit for 3 seconds (max 3 stacks). Burnt units are dealt 4-8 damage per stack per second.
Burn.effectCn: 命中时施加1层燃烧，效果持续3秒（最高3层）。每层燃烧每秒造成4-8伤害。

Cell.name: Cell
Cell.effect: Splits into a clone on hit 2 times.
Cell.effectCn: 被击中2次后分裂出1颗相同的弹珠。

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.effect: Each hit has a 40 chance of charming the enemy for 5 seconds. Charmed units walk up the board and attack enemies.
Charm.effectCn: 每次命中时有40几率魅惑敌人，效果持续5秒。被魅惑的单位将会转而向上方移动并攻击其他敌人。

Dark.name: Dark
Dark.effect: Deals 300x damage but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Dark.effectCn: 造成300x伤害，但是在命中敌人后将自毁。每次发射后需要等待3秒冷却时间。

Earthquake.name: Earthquake
Earthquake.effect: Deals 5-13 damage to nearby units in a 3x3 tile square
Earthquake.effectCn: 对3x3格范围内的单位造成5-13伤害

Egg Sac.name: Egg Sac
Egg Sac.effect: Explodes into 2-4 baby balls on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Egg Sac.effectCn: 命中敌人时分裂出2-4颗迷你弹珠。每次发射后需要等待3秒冷却时间。

Freeze.name: Freeze
Freeze.effect: Has a 4 chance to freeze enemies for 50 seconds. Frozen enemies receive 25 more damage
Freeze.effectCn: 有4几率冰冻敌人，效果持续50秒。被冰冻的敌人将额外承受25伤害

Iron.name: Iron
Iron.effect: Deals double damage but moves 40 slower
Iron.effectCn: 造成双倍伤害，但是移动速度减慢40

Laser (Horizontal).name: Laser (Horizontal)
Laser (Horizontal).effect: Deals 9-18 damage to all enemies in the same row
Laser (Horizontal).effectCn: 对同一行的所有敌人造成9-18伤害。

Laser (Vertical).name: Laser (Vertical)
Laser (Vertical).effect: Deals 9-18 damage to all enemies in the same column
Laser (Vertical).effectCn: 对同一列的所有敌人造成9-18伤害。

Light.name: Light
Light.effect: Blinds enemies on hit for 3 seconds. Blinded units have a hard time detecting you and have a 50% chance of missing when they attack.
Light.effectCn: 命中时使敌人致盲，效果持续3秒。致盲的敌人将难以察觉到你的存在，并且攻击时有50%几率失手。

Lightning.name: Lightning
Lightning.effect: Deals 1-20 damage to up to 3 nearby enemies
Lightning.effectCn: 对附近至多3名敌人造成1-20伤害

Poison.name: Poison
Poison.effect: Applies 1 stack of poison on hit (max 5 stacks). Poison lasts for 6 seconds and each stack deals 1-4 damage per second
Poison.effectCn: 命中时施加1层中毒（最高5层）。中毒持续6秒，每层中毒每秒造成1-4伤害。

Vampire.name: Vampire
Vampire.effect: Each hit has a 45 chance of healing 1 health
Vampire.effectCn: 每次命中时有45几率恢复1点生命值

Wind.name: Wind
Wind.effect: Passes through enemies and slows them down by 30 for 5 seconds, but deals 25% less damage.
Wind.effectCn: 仅造成75%伤害，但是能够穿过敌人并使其减速30，效果持续5秒。

Stone.name: Stone
Stone.effect: Initially deals 300 damage. Damage erodes by 40 each time hitting an enemy (minimum 50).
Stone.effectCn: 最初造成300伤害。每次命中敌人时伤害降低40（最低50）。

Time.name: Time
Time.effect: Explodes into a time snare upon hitting an enemy, which stays on the field for 20 seconds and freezes enemies inside it.
Time.effectCn: 命中敌人时爆炸并展开一片时间陷阱，陷阱将在场上停留20秒，并且冻结范围内的所有敌人。

Leech.name: Leech
Leech.effect: Attaches up to 1 leech onto enemies it hits, which adds 2 stacks of bleed per second (Max 24 stacks)
Leech.effectCn: 命中时对敌人施加至多1层吸血水蛭，吸血水蛭每秒施加2层流血（最高24层流血）

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.effect: Each hit has a 30 chance of causing enemies to go berserk for 6 seconds. Berserk enemies deal 15-24 damage to adjacent enemies every second.
Berserk.effectCn: 每次命中有30几率使敌人狂暴，效果持续6秒。狂暴的敌人将对毗邻的其他敌人造成每秒15-24伤害。

Sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
Sacrifice.effect: Inflicts 4 stacks of bleed (Max 15 stacks) and applies curse to hit enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 50-100 after being hit 5 times.
Sacrifice.effectCn: 命中时施加4层流血（最高15层）以及诅咒。被诅咒的敌人在受到5次攻击后将承受50-100伤害。

Hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
Hemorrhage.effect: Inflicts 3 stacks of bleed. When hitting an enemy with 12 stacks of bleed or more, consumes all stacks of bleed to deal 20 of their current health.
Hemorrhage.effectCn: 施加3层流血。如果敌人身上的流血效果有12层或以上，击中敌人时将消耗所有流血层数，并造成等同于敌人最大生命值20的伤害。

Vampire Lord.name: Vampire Lord
Vampire Lord.effect: Each hit inflicts 3 stacks of bleed. Heals 1 health and consumes all stacks when hitting an enemy with at least 10 stacks of bleed.
Vampire Lord.effectCn: 每次命中时施加3层流血。如果敌人身上有10层流血效果或以上，击中敌人时将消耗所有流血层数，并为你恢复1点生命值。

Maggot.name: Maggot
Maggot.effect: Infest enemies on hit with maggots. When they die, they explode into 1-2 baby balls
Maggot.effectCn: 命中时将使敌人被蛆虫缠身。这些敌人死亡时将会分裂出1-2颗迷你弹珠

Spider Queen.name: Spider Queen
Spider Queen.effect: Has a 25 chance of birthing an Egg Sac each time it hits an enemy
Spider Queen.effectCn: 每次命中敌人时有25几率创造1颗巢囊

Mosquito King.name: Mosquito King
Mosquito King.effect: Spawns a mosquito each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing 80 - 120 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 1 health.
Mosquito King.effectCn: 每次命中敌人时生成1只蚊子。蚊子将会对随机敌人发起攻击，并造成80-120伤害。如果蚊子成功杀死敌人，它们将能够为你窃取1点生命值。

Magma.name: Magma
Magma.effect: Emits lava blobs over time. Enemies who walk into lava blobs are dealt 15 - 30 damage and gain 1 stack of burn (max 3 stacks). Burn lasts for 3 seconds, dealing  3-8 damage per stack per second.  This ball and its lava blobs also deal 6-12 damage to nearby units.
Magma.effectCn: 持续释放岩浆池。经过岩浆池的敌人将承受15-30伤害以及1层燃烧（最高3层）。燃烧持续3秒，每层燃烧每秒造成3-8伤害。除此以外，此弹珠与释放的岩浆池在命中时还会对周遭敌人造成6-12伤害。

Frozen Flame.name: Frozen Flame
Frozen Flame.effect: Add 1 stack of frostburn on hit for 20 seconds (max 4 stacks). Frostburnt units are dealt 8-12 damage per stack per second and receive 25 more damage from other sources.
Frozen Flame.effectCn: 命中时施加1层霜燃，效果持续20秒（最高4层）。每层霜燃每秒造成8-12伤害，并且使目标敌人承受的其他伤害提高25。

Bomb.name: Bomb
Bomb.effect: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 150-300 damage to nearby enemies. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Bomb.effectCn: 命中敌人时爆炸，对周遭敌人造成150-300伤害。每次发射后需要等待3秒冷却时间。

Sun.name: Sun
Sun.effect: Blind all enemies in view and add 1 stack of burn every second (max 5 stacks). Burn lasts for 6 seconds and deals 6-12 damage per stack per second.
Sun.effectCn: 使视野中的所有敌人致盲，并且每秒施加1层燃烧（最高5层）。燃烧持续6秒，每层燃烧每秒造成6-12伤害。

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.effect: Applies 1 stack of burn every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius. Burn lasts for 6 seconds, dealing 3-7 damage per stack per second.
Inferno.effectCn: 每秒对2格范围内的敌人施加1层燃烧。燃烧效果持续6秒，每层燃烧每秒造成3-7伤害。

Overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
Overgrowth.effect: Applies 1 stack of overgrowth. Upon reaching 3, consume all stacks and deal 150-200 damage to all enemies in a 3x3 tile square.
Overgrowth.effectCn: 施加1层蔓延。堆叠3层后，消耗所有层数并对3x3格范围内的所有敌人造成150-200伤害。

Radiation Beam.name: Radiation Beam
Radiation Beam.effect: Emit a radiation beam on hit that deals 24-48 damage and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks). Radiation lasts for 15 seconds and cause enemies to receive 10 more damage from all sources per stack.
Radiation Beam.effectCn: 命中时释放一道辐射光束，造成24-48伤害并施加1层核辐射（最高5层）。核辐射持续15秒，每层核辐射使敌人额外承受10的所有来源伤害。

Virus.name: Virus
Virus.effect: Applies 1 stack of disease to units it hits (max 8 stacks). Disease lasts for 6 seconds. Each stack of disease deals 3-6 damage per second and diseased units have a 15 chance of passing a stack to undiseased nearby enemies each second.
Virus.effectCn: 命中时施加1层瘟疫（最高8层）。瘟疫持续6秒。每层瘟疫每秒造成3-6伤害，除此以外，承受瘟疫的敌人每秒有15%几率向周遭的健康敌人传染1层瘟疫。

Incubus.name: Incubus
Incubus.effect: Each hit has a 40 chance of charming the enemy for 9 seconds. Charmed enemies curse nearby enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 100-200 after being hit 5 times.
Incubus.effectCn: 每次命中时有40几率魅惑敌人，效果持续9秒。被魅惑的敌人将诅咒周遭的敌人。被诅咒的敌人在受到5次攻击后将承受100-200伤害。

Lovestruck.name: Lovestruck
Lovestruck.effect: Inflicts lovestruck on hit enemies for 20 seconds. Lovestruck units have a 50% chance of healing you for 5 health when they attack.
Lovestruck.effectCn: 对命中的敌人施加热恋，效果持续20秒。陷入热恋的单位在发起攻击时将有50%几率转而为你恢复5点生命值。

Succubus.name: Succubus
Succubus.effect: Each hit has a 40 chance of charming the enemy for 9 seconds. Heals 1 when hitting a charmed enemy.
Succubus.effectCn: 每次命中时有40几率魅惑敌人，效果持续9秒。命中被魅惑的敌人时恢复1点生命值。

Phantom.name: Phantom
Phantom.effect: Curse enemies on hit. Cursed enemies are dealt 100-200 damage after being hit 5 times.
Phantom.effectCn: 命中时施加诅咒。被诅咒的敌人在受到5次攻击后将承受100-200伤害。

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.effect: Passes through the front of enemies, but not the back. Backstabs deal 30 bonus damage.
Assassin.effectCn: 从正面穿过敌人，但是不会穿过敌人的后背。背刺造成30额外伤害。

Flicker.name: Flicker
Flicker.effect: Deals 1-7 damage to every enemy on screen every 14 seconds.
Flicker.effectCn: 每隔14秒对场上的所有敌人造成1-7伤害。

Noxious.name: Noxious
Noxious.effect: Passes through enemies and applies 3 stacks of poison to nearby enemies within a 2 tile radius. Poison lasts for 4 seconds and each stack deals 1-3 damage per second.
Noxious.effectCn: 穿过敌人，并且对其周遭3格范围内的所有敌人施加2层中毒。中毒持续4秒，每层中毒每秒造成1-3伤害。

Glacier.name: Glacier
Glacier.effect: Releases glacial spikes over time that deal 15-30 to enemies that touch them and freeze them for 20 seconds. This ball and its glacial spikes also deal 6-12 damage to nearby units.
Glacier.effectCn: 持续释放冰刺，对触碰冰刺的敌人造成15-30伤害，并且施加冰冻，持续20秒。除此以外，此弹珠与释放的冰刺在命中时还会对周遭敌人造成6-12伤害。

Swamp.name: Swamp
Swamp.effect: Leaves behind tar blobs over time. Enemies who walk into tar blobs are dealt 15 - 30, are slowed by 50 for 7 seconds and gain 1 stack of poison (max 8 stacks). Each stack of poison deals  1-3 damage per second.  This ball and its tar blobs also deal 6-12 damage to nearby units.
Swamp.effectCn: 持续释放焦油池。焦油池将对经过的敌人造成15-30伤害，持续7秒的50减速，以及1层中毒（最高8层）每层中毒每秒造成1-3伤害。除此以外，此弹珠与释放的焦油池在命中时还会对周遭敌人造成6-12伤害。

Sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
Sandstorm.effect: Goes through enemies and is surrounded by a raging storm dealing 10-20 damage per second and blinding nearby enemies for 3 seconds.
Sandstorm.effectCn: 穿过敌人，此弹珠受到沙暴笼罩，每秒造成10-20伤害并使敌人致盲，效果持续3秒。

Shotgun.name: Shotgun
Shotgun.effect: Shoots 3-7 iron baby balls after hitting a wall. Iron baby balls move at 200 speed but are destroyed upon hitting anything.
Shotgun.effectCn: 每次命中墙壁时发射3-7颗迷你黑铁弹珠。迷你黑铁弹珠的移动速度高达200，但是命中任意敌人后将自毁。

Wraith.name: Wraith
Wraith.effect: Freezes any enemy it passes through for 8 seconds
Wraith.effectCn: 冰冻经过的敌人，效果持续8秒

Freeze Ray.name: Freeze Ray
Freeze Ray.effect: Emits a freeze ray when hitting an enemy, dealing  20-50 to all enemies in its path, with a 10 chance of freezing them for 100 seconds
Freeze Ray.effectCn: 命中敌人时发射一道冰冻射线，射线将对路径上的所有敌人造成20-50伤害，并且有10几率冰冻敌人，效果持续100秒

Blizzard.name: Blizzard
Blizzard.effect: Freezes all enemies within a 2 tile radius for 8 seconds, dealing 1-50 damage.
Blizzard.effectCn: 冰冻2格范围内的所有敌人并造成1-50伤害，冰冻效果持续8秒。

Soul Sucker.name: Soul Sucker
Soul Sucker.effect: Passes through enemies and saps them, with a 300 chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 20. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy.
Soul Sucker.effectCn: 穿过敌人，有300几率窃取1生命值并且使敌人的攻击伤害降低20。吸血几率只能对每名敌人作用1次。

Holy Laser.name: Holy Laser
Holy Laser.effect: Deals 24-36 damage to all enemies in the same row and column
Holy Laser.effectCn: 对同一行同一列的所有敌人造成24-36伤害。

Laser Beam.name: Laser Beam
Laser Beam.effect: Emit a laser beam on hit that deals 30-42 damage and blinds enemies for 8 seconds.
Laser Beam.effectCn: 命中时发射一道激光束，造成30-42伤害并且使敌人致盲，效果持续8秒。

Flash.name: Flash
Flash.effect: Damage all enemies on screen for 1 - 3 damage after hitting an enemy and blind them for 2 seconds.
Flash.effectCn: 命中一名敌人后对场上的所有敌人造成1-3伤害，并使其致盲，效果持续2秒。

Lightning Rod.name: Lightning Rod
Lightning Rod.effect: Plants a lightning rod into enemies it hits. These enemies are struck by lightning every 30 seconds, dealing 1-30 damage to up to 8 nearby enemies
Lightning Rod.effectCn: 命中时在敌人身上放置1个避雷针。被插上避雷针的敌人将每隔30秒被闪电击中，并且对其周遭至多8名敌人造成1-30伤害

Storm.name: Storm
Storm.effect: Emits lightning to strike nearby enemies every second, dealing 1-40 damage.
Storm.effectCn: 释放闪电打击周围的敌人，每秒造成1-40伤害。

Mosquito Swarm.name: Mosquito Swarm
Mosquito Swarm.effect: Explodes into 3-6 mosquitos. Mosquitos attack random enemies, dealing 80 - 120 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 1 health.
Mosquito Swarm.effectCn: 分裂出3-6只蚊子。蚊子将会对随机敌人发起攻击，并造成80-120伤害。如果蚊子成功杀死敌人，它们将能够为你窃取1点生命值。

Voluptuous Egg Sac.name: Voluptuous Egg Sac
Voluptuous Egg Sac.effect: Explodes into 2-3 egg sacs on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Voluptuous Egg Sac.effectCn: 命中敌人时分裂出2-3颗巢囊每次发射后需要等待3秒冷却时间。

Steel.name: Steel
Steel.effect: Initially deals double damage but moves 50 slower. Damage increases by 10 each time it hits an enemy (max 300).
Steel.effectCn: 最初造成双倍伤害，但是移动速度减慢50。每次命中敌人时伤害提高10（最高300）。

Catapult.name: Catapult
Catapult.effect: Launches 3-5 stone baby balls every 15 seconds, which are destroyed after hitting anything.
Catapult.effectCn: 每隔15秒发射3-5迷你岩石弹珠，岩石弹珠在命中任意敌人后将自毁。

Landslide.name: Landslide
Landslide.effect: Creates a landslide and destroys self upon hitting an enemy. The landslide lasts for 5 seconds and deals 20-30 damage / second to enemies within a 2 tile radius.
Landslide.effectCn: 命中敌人时自爆并创造一片地裂区域。地裂区域将持续5秒，并且每秒对2格范围内的敌人造成20-30伤害。

Brimstone.name: Brimstone
Brimstone.effect: Applies 1 stack of burn and poison every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius (max 4 stacks). Burn deals 1-4 damage per stack per second and poison deals 2-3 damage per stack per second.
Brimstone.effectCn: 每秒对2格范围内的敌人施加1层燃烧与中毒（最高4层）。每层燃烧每秒造成1-4伤害，每层中毒每秒造成2-3伤害。

Petrify.name: Petrify
Petrify.effect: Petrifies all enemies within its sightline for 15 seconds when first launched, dealing 50-120.
Petrify.effectCn: 使发射时位于弹珠视野范围内的所有敌人石化并造成50-120伤害，效果持续15秒。

Fireworks.name: Fireworks
Fireworks.effect: Explodes into 3-6 fireworks. Fireworks target random enemies, dealing 20 - 30 damage and applying 1 stack of burn. Burnt units are dealt 7-11 damage per stack per second.
Fireworks.effectCn: 命中敌人时分裂出3-6颗烟花。分裂出的烟花将追踪随机敌人，造成20-30伤害并施加1层燃烧。每层燃烧每秒造成7-11伤害。

Venom.name: Venom
Venom.effect: Applies 1 stack of venom on hit (max 8 stacks). Each stack deals 3-6 damage per second and slows down enemies.
Venom.effectCn: 命中时施加1层剧毒（最高8层）。每层剧毒每秒造成3-6伤害，并且使敌人减速。

Heart Swallower.name: Heart Swallower
Heart Swallower.effect: Saps enemies on hit, with a 400 chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 20. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy.
Heart Swallower.effectCn: 命中敌人时，有400几率窃取1点生命值，并使敌人的攻击伤害降低20。吸血几率只能对每名敌人作用1次。

Banished Flame.name: Banished Flame
Banished Flame.effect: Add 1 stack of darkflame on hit for 2 seconds (max 6 stacks). Darkflame deals 1-30 damage per stack per second. When the darkflame goes out, it deals 1-100 to the enemy.
Banished Flame.effectCn: 命中时施加1层暗焰，效果持续2秒（最高6层）。每层暗焰每秒造成1-30伤害。暗焰熄灭时将对敌人造成1-100伤害。

Timestop.name: Timestop
Timestop.effect: Freezes everything on the field for 50 seconds but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 30 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Timestop.effectCn: 使场上的所有目标冻结50秒，但是弹珠将在命中敌人后自毁。每次发射后需要等待30秒冷却时间。

Warp.name: Warp
Warp.effect: After each hit, warps to a random spot on the field and speeds up by 5
Warp.effectCn: 每次命中敌人后，弹珠将跃迁至场上的随机位置并获得5速度提升。

Erosion.name: Erosion
Erosion.effect: Passes through enemies. Deals 3 of enemy's current health as bonus damage on hit.
Erosion.effectCn: 穿过敌人。命中时造成等同于敌人当前生命值的3的额外伤害。

Offspring.name: Offspring
Offspring.effect: Splits into a clone on hit 4 times.
Offspring.effectCn: 被击中4次后分裂出1颗相同的弹珠。

Flesh Mound.name: Flesh Mound
Flesh Mound.effect: Emits a fleshy baby ball in a random direction every 10 seconds.
Flesh Mound.effectCn: 每隔10秒朝随机方向发射一颗肉块迷你弹珠。

Zombie.name: Zombie
Zombie.effect: Infects enemies on hit, giving them a 40 chance to turn into a friendly zombie on death
Zombie.effectCn: 命中时感染敌人，被感染的敌人在死亡时有40几率转化为1个友方僵尸。

Nuclear Bomb.name: Nuclear Bomb
Nuclear Bomb.effect: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 300-500 damage to nearby enemies and applying 1 stack of radiation to everyone present indefinitely (max 5 stacks). Each stack of radiation increases damage received by 10. Has a 3 second cooldown.
Nuclear Bomb.effectCn: 命中敌人时爆炸，对周遭敌人造成300-500伤害，并且对场上所有人施加1层核辐射，核辐射效果将永久持续（最高5层）。每层核辐射使敌人额外承受10伤害。发射后有3秒冷却时间。

Black Hole.name: Black Hole
Black Hole.effect: Instantly kills the first non-boss enemy that it hits, but destroys itself afterwards. Has a 7 second cooldown before it can be shot again.
Black Hole.effectCn: 立即击杀命中的第一个敌人（非Boss），但是之后将自毁。每次发射后需要等待7秒冷却时间。

Satan.name: Satan
Satan.effect: While active, add 1 stack of burn to all active enemies per second (max 5 stacks), dealing 10-20 damage per stack per second and make them go berserk, dealing 15-24 damage to adjacent enemies every second.
Satan.effectCn: 存在于场上时，每秒对所有敌人施加1层燃烧（最高5层），每层燃烧每秒造成10-20伤害，除此以外使敌人狂暴，狂暴的敌人将对毗邻的其他敌人造成每秒15-24伤害。

Nosferatu.name: Nosferatu
Nosferatu.effect: Spawns a vampire bat each bounce. Vampire bats fly towards a random enemy, dealing 132-176 damage on hit, turning into a Vampire Lord.
Nosferatu.effectCn: 每次反弹时生成1只吸血蝙蝠。吸血蝙蝠将飞向一名随机敌人，命中时造成132-176伤害，之后蝙蝠将变成1颗吸血鬼领主。

Banshee.name: Banshee
Banshee.effect: Curses all enemies while on the field when launched. Cursed enemies are dealt 150-300 after being hit 6 times.
Banshee.effectCn: 发射后诅咒场上的所有敌人。被诅咒的敌人在受到6次攻击后将承受150-300伤害。

Reaper.name: Reaper
Reaper.effect: Has a 10 chance to kill enemies on impact, healing you for 5 health.
Reaper.effectCn: 撞击目标时有10几率立即杀死敌人，并为你恢复5生命值。

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.effect: Pierces enemies and shoots 3-7 sniper baby balls after hitting a wall. Sniper baby balls pierce enemies but are destroyed upon hitting a wall.
Sniper.effectCn: 击中墙壁后穿透敌人并射出3-7枚狙击手迷你弹珠。狙击手迷你弹珠可以穿透敌人，但碰到墙壁后立即摧毁。

Time Bomb.name: Time Bomb
Time Bomb.effect: Throws a time bomb every few seconds, which explodes after a delay, dealing 80-120 damage to nearby enemies.
Time Bomb.effectCn: 每隔数秒投掷一枚时间炸弹，炸弹将在短暂延迟后引爆，对附近敌人造成80-120伤害。

Tumor.name: Tumor
Tumor.effect: Applies tumor on hit. Enemies with a tumor die after 40 seconds (except for bosses).
Tumor.effectCn: 命中时施加肿瘤。受肿瘤影响的敌人（除Boss以外）将在40秒后死亡。

X Ray.name: X Ray
X Ray.effect: Emits an X-shaped laser on hit, which deals 50-75 damage to enemies and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks). Radiation causes enemies to receive 10 more damage from all sources per stack.
X Ray.effectCn: 命中时施放一道X形激光，激光将对敌人造成50-75伤害，并且施加1层核辐射（最高5层）。每层核辐射使敌人额外承受10的所有来源伤害。

Laser Cutter.name: Laser Cutter
Laser Cutter.effect: Constantly emits a laser in front of it, which deals 100-150 per second.
Laser Cutter.effectCn: 持续朝正前方发射激光，每秒造成100-150伤害。

Elemental.name: Elemental
Elemental.effect: Applies a random status effect (burn, slow, or freeze) to nearby enemies on hit.
Elemental.effectCn: 命中时对附近敌人施加1种随机状态效果（燃烧、减速或冰冻）。
